info.name: Webhook Delivery REST API
info.description: This is a Postman collection for a **NestJS webhook delivery API**. It covers JWT authentication, project and webhook endpoint management, event publishing, webhook dispatch, delivery status tracking, and manual retry for failed deliveries.
